title: Sign-up, verification and account security
caption: What the API does for the portal's sign-up, verify, MFA set-up and password reset screens.

steps.title: Sign up
steps.body: Portal `/sign-up` → `signUp`. Password: 12+ characters with a letter and a digit, not on the breached list.
steps.expect: `202`; `auth.verify_email` e-mail; weak password `422 PASSWORD_TOO_WEAK`; 6th sign-up from one IP within an hour `429 RATE_LIMITED`.

steps.title: Turn on MFA
steps.body: `startMfaSetup` (secret kept encrypted in Redis `mfasetup:<accountId>` for 10 min, returns otpauth URL) then `enableMfa {code}`.
steps.expect: `accounts.mfa_enabled = true`; recovery codes shown once; e-mail `auth.mfa_changed`; vx:invalidate account.

steps.title: Reset a forgotten password
steps.expect: `202` whatever the address; after confirm every session revoked, `staffdeny:acct:<id>` written, `auth.password_changed` e-mail.
